commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90+1' Almeria take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) for a tough tackle.
89' Marko Milovanovic (Almeria) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the crossbar to safety.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
88' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.
86' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
84' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Victor Garcia ignores the protests.
83' The attendance is 12863.
82' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
78' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
76' Marko Milovanovic (Almeria) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
75' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
74' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao) replacing Alex Berenguer.
72' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
71' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
66' Substitution. Mikel Vesga did his best and is replaced by Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao).
66' The substitution has been made. Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) has replaced Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
66' Substitution. Marko Milovanovic (Almeria) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Choco Lozano walks off.
66' Gaizka Garitano has decided to make a change. Adrian Embarba (Almeria) replaces Sergio Arribas.
66' That's the end of the game for Alejandro Centelles Plaza, who is replaced by Bruno Langa (Almeria).

60' A pass into the penalty area from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by the defence. The ball is out of play and Ath Bilbao manage to earn a corner.
59' Luis Maximiano is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao). Easy save!
58' The referee blows his whistle as Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) was too aggressive in his challenge.
57' The ball is behind the touchline and Ath Bilbao will take a throw-in.

52' The corner is swung in but Almeria can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
51' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. It will be a corner kick for Almeria.
50' Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
48' It's time for a substitution. Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) comes on in place of Dion Lopy.
46' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to substitute Asier Villalibre and he is replaced by Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).

46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Victor Garcia has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' What a save from Unai Simon! Choco Lozano (Almeria) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
45' Marc Pubill (Almeria) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
42' Almeria have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
40' The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
39' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.
37' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes.
35' A pass into the box finds Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Luis Maximiano denies him.
34' Caution goes to Marc Pubill (Almeria).
31' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
27' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
24' Dion Lopy (Almeria) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
24' Marc Pubill (Almeria) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
23' Ath Bilbao take a short corner kick.

22' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
20' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Almeria will take a throw-in.
18' A brilliant cross into the box finds Lucas Robertone (Almeria), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
16' Choco Lozano (Almeria) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Almeria.
11' Choco Lozano (Almeria) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Unai Simon is equal to it and makes an easy save.
10' Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The linesman signals a throw-in for Almeria.
9' A quickly taken corner by Almeria.
7' Almeria enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' Great teamplay by Ath Bilbao as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
